title: The Raft Consensus Algorithm (paper, visualisation and implementations)
author: Diego Ongaro and John Ousterhout
why: The home of Raft: the original paper, an interactive cluster you can crash, and a list of implementations.

title: The Secret Lives of Data: Raft
author: Ben Johnson
why: A step-by-step animated walkthrough of election and log replication; ideal before reading the paper.

title: Paxos Made Simple
author: Leslie Lamport
why: Lamport's own short explanation of single-decree Paxos and how it extends to a replicated state machine.

title: etcd documentation
author: etcd authors
why: Leases, watches, transactions and the election and lock APIs, plus guidance on cluster sizing.
